description: Neuroscience A15 event detector: deterministic per-recording STFT feature extraction with 1 ms hop, 24 log-spaced triangular bands (250–12000 Hz), broadband log-energy, and 5/15 ms smoothed broadband features. Noise-floor normalization subtracts each recording’s 20th-percentile log-energy (exact for validation/test, approximate via sparse sampling for non-validation training). A HistGradientBoostingClassifier is trained using up to 60k uniformly sampled frames. Threshold, gap-fill, and minimum-duration hyperparameters are selected by mean event F1 on a fixed validation subset of training recordings, using maximum-cardinality bipartite matching under the specified onset/offset tolerances. The classifier is then refit on all training recordings (re-using computed features where possible), and predictions are post-processed on test recordings to produce 1 ms binary rasters with zeros in padding. Deterministic seeds used; single-thread numeric workload; memory-conscious, streaming per recording.
